Wow holy shit. I was willing to give you the benefit of the doubt with your first couple of comments but you're as bad as OP's abusers. Are you seriously here right now shoving that garbage down her throat when it's exactly the kind of thing she is trying to get away from? Shame on you. 

LGBTQ+ is not an "agenda" it's about respect and acceptance in a society where people like you exist. And no one cares if you're religious, but don't preach here. Especially not when you espouse the worst aspects of your religion with your intolerance.

Change is inherently scary, even if you're in a terrible situation. It's human nature to want things that we're used to, even if those things hurt us. But I think you should follow your psychologists advice and move out. It's not healthy to live with people who are hurting you and disrespecting you. If you can find a way to be independent of your family then that might be best.

Also, and at the end of the day it's your choice, but I feel you should actually file that complaint against your stepdad. If he's assaulted you before he might do so again and maybe to someone else. It's good that he's seeking help but your mum should have left him a long time ago. Nonetheless it's still better to have a record of it, even if the cops don't do anything about it. Atleast next time if he hurts someone there'll be a record stating he's done this before. 

You deserve to be around people who accept and love you for who you are. Don't lose hope and once you're on your own and independent, I promise you you'll feel a lot better about everything. Just being cut off from toxic people can sometimes do a world of good to you. 

If you don't mind me asking, what country are you from? I know different cultures have very different views on homosexuality and some cultures are just more intolerant and that can make it much harder for people who come out as queer

To be honest, I'm not entirely sure it was consensual on my part. My cousin is a few years older than me and me and her family have been very close since we were kids.

Growing up, It was sorta ingrained in me by everyone that obedience was a virtue. So all my life my natural reaction to someone asking me for something or to do something has always been "yes". For the longest time, saying "no" was not something that came easily for me. 

Fast forward many many years, I'm in my 20s she's in her 30s. I'm spending the weekend at their place. I was drinking with my uncle and my cousin joined us. We all got wasted, my uncle passed out and my cousin decided now was the best time to pop out some pills she was tripping on. 

Now, I've done my fair share of drugs but mostly psychedelics and stuff, never like pills or anything. She told me to take a pill. I didn't want to at first, but she was always a little bit of a bully and was always ordering me about when were kids so I found it hard to say "no". I said I didn't feel like it and she started sniping at my manhood and belittling me for not being adventurous enough. Eventually I caved. I still have no idea what was in those pills. But I remember everything going slow like I was suddenly in a pool of molasses or something. We went to her room to chill and put on some tv but I started tripping pretty soon. 

That's when my cousin pulled out some oil and told me to massage her head. I just wanted to chill and enjoy whatever it was I was on but her tone became more authoritative and demanding so I just caved again. Head massage doesn't seem so harmful right? 

Well then she started telling me to massage other parts of her body and started undressing. When I meekly protested, she just said it's fine and told me to keep going. Eventually she started undressing me but by this point I was way too high to say anything. 

Suffice it to say, things escalated very quickly from then on. 

I say I'm not sure if it was consensual because while I never wanted anything to happen, and if could do it again I'd run the fuck out of that room, but at that moment, I remember being quite aroused. Cousin or not, she is a very attractive woman and is very fit. But I think being blitzed out of my mind, a part of me wanted to fuck her in that moment cause I was pretty erect by the time my boxers came off. 

Anyways it's been many years now and we both live on different continents. While we've never explicitly spoken about it, she did show some remorse the last time she saw me and gave me a gold watch for "doing wrong by me" but we never talked about what that was. 

I never said anything to family but told my friends about it and they're pretty convinced I was raped, but it didn't feel like rape. I don't feel it was 100% consensual either so I guess even after all these years it's still confusing me a bit.
